$comment: G4 dismissal rules (plan 4.6): structural accessibility nodes dismissed by a named rule. Schema of a rule: {"id": string, "controlType": string (UIA control type the rule applies to), "namePattern": optional regular expression on the node's label, "why": string}. An L01 observation names a rule in `dismissed_by`; validate.ts re-applies the rule's predicate and fails a dismissal it does not match. Empty until the Phase 4 accessibility walk; main-owned.
